title: The Swiss constitution's English text mentions the independence and neutrality of Switzerland as an object of federal measures
summary: The Swiss constitution's English text mentions the independence and neutrality of Switzerland as an object of federal measures.
body: The English translation contains a provision on safeguarding the independence and neutrality of Switzerland, in the passage on exceptional federal measures. The source says: "Further duties and powers The Federal Assembly has the following additional duties and powers: taking measures to safeguard external security and the independence and neutrality of Switzerland." Neutrality appears in that passage of the translation. The card does not convert the word into a history of Swiss foreign policy. The English text has no legal force, as the compilation itself says.
